scientific_integrity: Fixed-parameter invariant-density existence and Sobolev regularity come from cited work; existing fixed-parameter endpoint identities are not claimed as novel. The new contribution concerns degeneration as the cusp strength tends to zero and the distinct rescaled endpoint profiles.
scientific_limitations: The two boundary layers and scaled derivative limits hold only for the stated deterministic square-root cusp family with parameter tending to 2. The second-derivative bound is a liminf, not an asserted exact norm asymptotic; uniformity is on compact scaled intervals, not globally. Historical priority is provisional, with residual risk of unindexed boundary-layer literature.
title: Distinct universal endpoint layers when a square-root cusp disappears
